device.description: The block device path for the CD-ROM drive to configure.

auto_close.description: Set -c: Close tray when mounting a data CD if the tray is open.

auto_open.description: Set -o: Eject tray when the last process using the CD closes the device.

use_fflags.description: Set -f: Use O_NONBLOCK semantics, disabling type checking and tray manipulation for ioctls.

locking.description: Set -l: Lock the drive door while the CD-ROM device is open/mounted.

type_checking.description: Set -t: Verify the CD type (audio vs data) upon open/playing operations.

eject_sw.description: Set -e: Enable both auto-close and auto-open flags simultaneously.

playback_speed.description: Set -x speed: Head-rate multiplier for reading CDs (0=auto).

jukebox_drive.description: Set -d drive: Select the slot number in a jukebox/multi-disc player.
